item.title: December Jobs Report For Missouri
item.description: The State of Missouri’s Jobs report for December was released today. The report shows Missouri’s non-farm payroll increased by 800 jobs, private industry employment decreased by 800 jobs, and government employment increased by 1,600 jobs. Missouri’s smoothed seasonally adjusted unemployment rate decreased by one-tenth of a percentage point to 3.9%. That is one-tenth of a […]
